decision.title: fn:divide-decimals and the precision it supports (packet )
decision.summary: sxml_decimal_divide_to_precision computes divide-decimals exactly with libmpdec's truncating division, adjusting the precision to fit maximum_digit_count, and returns a map with xs:decimal "quotient" and "remainder".

item.p: Method: the divisor's power of ten is shifted by -precision (exact, no digits move) and libmpdec's truncating mpd_qdivint and mpd_qrem give quotient * 10^precision and the remainder value - quotient * divisor in one exact step each (F&O 4.0, section 4.3.1); the quotient has the sign of value / divisor, the remainder that of the value.

Precision range (the rules' "adjusted to the nearest value supported"): a positive precision is lowered until quotient and remainder both fit maximum_digit_count (bounds from the adjusted exponents and the divisor's digits), to 0 at least; one below every digit of the quotient is raised to just below it (the quotient is 0 either way). So divide-decimals(10, 3, 100_000) gives 9,997 decimal places at the default limit; an integer quotient wider than the limit is FOAR0002; a zero divisor FOAR0001.

Result: a map with keys "quotient" and "remainder" (xs:decimal), row result type record(quotient as xs:decimal, remainder as xs:decimal). It is not annotated with fn:division-record: no static context knows the F&O named record types yet (the Proposed item of ; QT4 divide-decimals-019 to -021 and fn-random-number-generator-35a to -37a wait for it).
